description: This file defines a React component for a page within a Next.js application, specifically the 'Journey/Roadmap' page. It includes UI components, visualization logic (such as a mind map and roadmap timeline), data modeling for roles and milestones, and utility functions relevant to the application's 'career navigation' feature.
